_comment: Copy to env.local.json / env.dev.json / env.prod.json and fill in your own values. Those files are gitignored from the public export because they name a specific deployment (#2953); this template is what tells you what to supply. Pass one with --dart-define-from-file=env.<environment>.json — the build:web:* and build:app:* npm scripts already do.
_comment_server: Base URL of your API server. Required for every ENVIRONMENT except 'local', which derives it (page origin on web, 10.0.2.2 on the Android emulator, localhost otherwise). Unset elsewhere means every RPC fails — deliberately, rather than silently reaching someone else's deployment.
_comment_oauth: OAuth web client id for Google Sign-In, from your identity provider's console.
_comment_firebase: Firebase web app config (Project settings -> Your apps -> Web). Required for web builds only; mobile reads google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist instead. FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY is NOT here on purpose: the build:web:* scripts fetch it from Secret Manager so it can be rotated without editing this file.
_comment_analytics: Optional. Only set if this deployment enables Analytics.
_comment_identity: This deployment's public-facing identity. Each is optional: TERMS_URL and PRIVACY_URL unset hides the two links under the SMS-consent disclosure (carrier A2P registration will reject that, so supply them before shipping SMS), and SUPPORT_EMAIL unset hides the login screen's contact-support link.
_comment_deeplink: Custom URL scheme for deep links. Defaults to 'ripls'. Changing it also requires editing the AndroidManifest.xml intent-filter and the iOS CFBundleURLSchemes entry — those are what route the URL to the app.
